types.name: AgentStatus
docs: Lifecycle status shared by `Delegate`.

types.name: AggregatedSig
docs: Aggregate Schnorr signature committed at settlement; not verified on the happy path.

types.name: CommittedNoncePair
docs: The nonce pair committed for one slot, as affine coordinates.
Points travel uncompressed so the program never pays for a field square root; both are
re-checked on-curve during equation verification.

types.name: Delegate
docs: Owner-scoped delegate authorization with persistent request quotas.

fields.name: status
docs: Owner pause / protocol freeze backstop.

fields.name: max_signers
docs: Per-delegate quorum ceiling; clamped to `plan.max_signers` at creation.

fields.name: value
docs: Stored oracle bytes: raw payload (`FeedValueKind::Value`) or keccak digest
(`FeedValueKind::Hash`). Never longer than [`Feed::STORED_VALUE_LEN`].

types.name: FeedValueKind
docs: Whether [`Feed::value`] holds the raw oracle payload or a digest of a longer payload.

types.name: Gateway
docs: Bonded, Ed25519-signing gateway (v0.2 spec `gateway.authority`).
Holds endpoint metadata, bond, and reward accounting. Keyed by the gateway's Solana
authority key. `index` is the `gateway_index` referenced by `GatewayReceipt`.

types.name: Node
docs: Permanent node identity and reward account; never closed or re-keyed.

types.name: OffenceKind
docs: Node-fault offence types. Each carries a fixed [`Penalty`] — see [`OffenceKind::penalty`].

types.name: PartialTranscript
docs: One partial-signature transcript: the challenge scalars and the resulting share.
The program never recomputes `b` or `c` from a signing context — the offence is defined purely
by the equation `s*G == R1 + b*R2 + c*X`, which is why message transport and commitment lists
stay off-chain.

fields.name: b
docs: Binding factor.

fields.name: c
docs: Challenge.

fields.name: s
docs: The node's partial signature scalar.

fields.name: max_delegates
docs: Max delegates/agents an owner on this plan may provision.

fields.name: max_settlement_delay_seconds
docs: Max age in seconds of `canonical_timestamp` relative to cluster time at
attestation/settlement ingress. Bounds the offline selection-grind space.

fields.name: reward_liability
docs: Sum of every `Node.claimable_rewards`. The treasury must always hold at least this much

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: Must match `nonce_reuse_evidence_hash(..)`; used as the `PunishmentCase` PDA seed.

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: Must match `equivocation_evidence_hash(..)`; used as the `PunishmentCase` PDA seed.

fields.name: registry_version
docs: Registry version that `node_index` indexes into; also bound into the batch signature.

fields.name: batch_meta
docs: Opaque batch header bytes, covered by the signature but not interpreted on-chain.

fields.name: batch_sig_s
docs: Single-key EVM-Schnorr signature over the batch message.

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: Must match `nonce_reuse_evidence_hash(..)`; used as the `PunishmentCase` PDA seed.

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: Must match `unsolicited_signing_evidence_hash(..)`; used as the `PunishmentCase` PDA seed.

types.name: PunishmentCase
docs: Permanent, on-chain record of an executed node punishment.
The PDA is seeded by `evidence_hash`, so `init` doubles as the anti-replay guard: the same
evidence can only ever be submitted once, independent of any per-offence terminal-status guard.

fields.name: registry_version
docs: Registry version the guilty bitmap indexes into.

types.name: Registry
docs: Immutable, version-addressed snapshot of the ordered node set and selection policy.
Only `nodes[..node_count]` is populated. Node addresses are stored as bytes to keep the
zero-copy layout POD-safe. `SPACE` includes the Anchor discriminator.

types.name: RegistryState
docs: Mutable pointer to the current immutable registry snapshot.

types.name: RoundReceiptRecord
docs: Per-round settlement record written by `settle_subscription_round` or `settle_x402_round`.

types.name: Secp256k1KeyClaim
docs: Permanent reservation for a secp256k1 node key.

fields.name: payer_id
docs: Rail-scoped payer identity for PDA seeds; not derivable on-chain.

fields.name: payment_ref
docs: Attested off-chain payment reference; not verified on-chain.

types.name: SignedStatement
docs: Signed statement submitted as punishment evidence.

fields.name: agg_sig_s
docs: Aggregate Schnorr scalar `s`.

fields.name: commitment_addr
docs: Ethereum-style commitment address of the aggregate nonce `R`.

types.name: SigningContext
docs: Duty tuple for one statement in a commitment-reuse filing.

fields.name: agg_sig_s
docs: Schnorr signature R component
